//: How orch provisions a seat worktree before its first turn (ops/orchestrator/src/worktrees.ts:provisionWorktree). ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH is the lead checkout. The two dependency steps install by APFS clonefile (cp -c -R, copy-on-write, near-zero disk; npm ci wrote ~360 MB per seat, 23.6 GB across 93 seat worktrees) when on macOS the target is absent and the source node_modules/.package-lock.json (the hidden lockfile npm writes on install, mirroring the tree actually installed) matches that directory package-lock.json packages object: the "" root entry npm omits there is ignored, member order is normalized, and an optional package npm skipped for the host platform (os/cpu/libc, mirroring npm-install-checks checkList exactly, including the negation early-false, the "any" shortcut and string lists) may be absent. Task 1525: a byte-equal lockfile proved nothing about the lead installed tree, so a stale lead node_modules was cloned into seats. Any mismatch, missing hidden lockfile, other platform, missing source or failed clone runs npm ci, which replaces node_modules wholesale, and logs the reason to the step tail. Optional parts guard themselves with || true; any other non-zero step fails the seat. Task 1803: a setup line containing any "gate" substring is heavy (npm ci, codegraph init) and runs inside a slot of the machine-local build gate (ops/orchestrator/build-gate.mjs --exec, slots in the machine's own orch state dir), locally and on remote hosts alike, so parallel seat provisioning cannot saturate a machine; light steps (copies, links, rtk trust) stay outside.
setup: if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ] && [ ! -e node_modules ] && [ -d "$ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/node_modules" ] && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const c=v=>JSON.stringify(v,(k,x)=>x&&typeof x=="object"&&!Array.isArray(x)?Object.keys(x).sort().reduce((o,q)=>(o[q]=x[q],o),{}):x);const host=(e,f,v)=>{let l=e&&e[f];if(!l)return true;if(typeof l=="string")l=[l];if(l.length==1&&l[0]=="any")return true;let m=false,n=0;for(const x of l){if(x.charAt(0)=="!"){n++;if(v==x.slice(1))return false}else{m=m||v==x}}return m||n==l.length};const p=f=>{const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"));if(!j.packages||!Object.keys(j.packages).length)throw new Error("no packages object in "+f);return j.packages};let a,b;try{a=p(process.argv[1]);b=p(process.argv[2])}catch(e){console.error("clone skipped: "+e.message);process.exit(1)}const skip=e=>e&&e.optional&&(!host(e,"os",process.platform)||!host(e,"cpu",process.arch)||(e.libc&&!host(e,"libc",process.platform=="linux"?"glibc":undefined)));const miss=Object.keys(b).filter(k=>k&&!(k in a)&&!skip(b[k]));if(miss.length){console.error("clone skipped: "+miss.length+" lockfile packages not installed in "+process.argv[1]+" (first: "+miss[0]+")");process.exit(1)}const extra=Object.keys(a).filter(k=>k&&!(k in b));if(extra.length){console.error("clone skipped: "+process.argv[1]+" holds packages the lockfile dropped (first: "+extra[0]+")");process.exit(1)}for(const k in a){if(k&&c(a[k])!==c(b[k])){console.error("clone skipped: "+k+" differs between the hidden lockfile and "+process.argv[2]);process.exit(1)}}process.exit(0)' "$ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/node_modules/.package-lock.json" package-lock.json; then cp -c -R "$ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/node_modules" node_modules || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; fi

then cp -c -R "$ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/ops/orchestrator/node_modules" ops/orchestrator/node_modules || npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix ops/orchestrator; else npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix ops/orchestrator; if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 && cmp -s .rtk/filters.toml "$ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.rtk/filters.toml" && rtk trust --list 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const win=process.platform==="win32";const norm=s=>{if(!win)return s;const p=s.replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(92),"/");return (p.startsWith("//?/")?p.slice(4):p).toLowerCase()};let list="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>list+=c).on("end",()=>process.exit(list.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).some(line=>norm(line).includes(norm(process.env.ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH+"/.rtk/filters.toml")))||win&&list.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).some(line=>line.trim()==="sha256:"+require("node:crypto").createHash("sha256").update(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.env.ORCH_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH+"/.rtk/filters.toml")).digest("hex"))?0:1))'; then rtk trust -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
